result.coverage_note: Reviewed all supplied PDF text. Figure pixels and supplementary materials were unavailable; this finding is supported by the main text.

findings.candidate_quote: the pipeline correctly identified expansions in 82% of DM1 subjects
findings.reference_quote:
All patients
with DM1 were confirmed by ONT sequencing having >50
repeats. Both patients with short and long expansions were
correctly detected (Fig. 2C, case dm_18 and dm_17 respectively).
A total of 28 out of 34 subjects (82%) with DM1 agreed
with SB data.
findings.explanation: The 82% measures agreement with Southern blot classification in 34 subjects, not expansion detection. ONT detected expansions in all DM1 patients. Despite the preceding statement that all cases were characterized, this sentence incorrectly presents a central diagnostic performance measure as an 82% detection rate.
